{"notes": "Visit 4 (left 6:30, about 3.5 min left). Table state: the bottom tail is now dark up to about (27, 8.9), but the pale tail above it (from about (27.3, 9.3) up and round to x~26, y~5) is still pale, so a gap under ~0.5 units remains. The back arc is still dark only to x~23, with pale stubs at 23.5-24.4 and a gap to the tail's top. The tail's only route is now through the belly join. Not yet connected. The 10:00 push is close.

Sofia: Sofia made a sensible, clearly communicated call. She stopped lifting, said why, and gave Omar the join. She also asked for a shout so she could verify. That's good collaboration and judgment, but she dropped the join she owned, and I still haven't seen her place pieces. Neutral until the tail goes dark. Next visit, check whether she actually verifies it.

Omar: Said at 6:15 that the bridge was in, with the last domino up into the tail. The table shows it nearly there but not connected. This is an overstatement, though he is actively checking and promised to shout. He is still the clearest leader and communicator, and he directed Sofia to stop lifting. Note for review: his 'bridge is in' claim was premature. Credit depends on whether it closes the last gap.

Hana: Heard nothing this visit. She is passive and dependent on the join. Her tail credit depends on the outcome.

Jack: Silent again. The bottom tail is dark, and Omar named him for it, but I haven't seen him build it. Ask him privately and don't assume."}
